text:
Riley: quick idea from the study: users want a low-key progress cue that doesn't steal attention but still shows liveliness when streaming.
Maya P: curious what that looks like. low-key = no big pulses, right?
Riley: yep. something like a faint left-edge glow that appears on chunk flush and fades fast. call it the "glowbar" in specs.
Samir: easy to surface from stream events. we can add `glowbar:true` and `chunk_index` to the stream payload. client-side render cheap.
Zoe (design): visual spec: 4px vertical glow on the bubble left, fade 90ms. disable for `prefers-reduced-motion`. name in CSS `--glowbar`.
Maya P: microcopy: change "Stop" to "Interrupt" in the playground. tooltip: "Interrupt generation and keep partial output". run a quick 6-person microcopy check.
Samir: dev note: also add `remaining_tokens_est` so UI can show "~120 to finish" under token counter. token-rate sparkline computed client-side from chunk timestamps.
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: 1) glowbar must not be the only cue; add `aria-live=polite` region for partial text. 2) provide alt text for token rate: "Token rate: X tokens per second". 3) ensure contrast in high-contrast mode.
Zoe (design): prompt dock tweak: collapsed by default while streaming, expandable, shows 3 pinned prompts. keyboard focusable and labeled as "Prompt Dock" region.
Maya P: also add a tiny odometer next to composer: "used f ~est" pattern. tappable to expand with sparkline and a short note: "Estimates may vary".
Samir: feature flag `playground_glowbar_v1`. will gate new payload fields. keyboard mapping: Esc -> Interrupt by default on playground iframe (configurable).
Riley: next steps  Zoe pushes frames, Maya runs microcopy, Samir wires flag + payload, a11y-bot to review.
deploy-bot: sandbox 2026-09-21T08:15:00 deployed (featureflag: playground_glowbar_v1).
